# The demo pack

What `vola demo-seed` uploads into the demo instance of the examples site (the compose
`seeder` service of the `demo` profile), from [`assets/`](assets/) as
[`assets/manifest.json`](assets/manifest.json) lists it.

## Where the files come from

**Every file is generated by [`scripts/make-assets.mjs`](scripts/make-assets.mjs)** — drawn
as SVG and rasterised with `sharp`, written as a minimal PDF by hand, or synthesised with
`ffmpeg`'s `testsrc2` and `sine` sources. Nothing is downloaded or copied from anywhere, so
the pack carries no third-party licence: it is part of this repository, MIT like the rest.

To regenerate it (after `pnpm install`, with `ffmpeg` on `PATH`):

```bash
node apps/examples/scripts/make-assets.mjs
```

| file | what | shown on |
|---|---|---|
| `images/aurora.jpg` | a 1600 × 1000 landscape of gradient bands and stars, JPEG q86 | Browse, Thumbnails |
| `images/geometry.png` | a 1200 × 1200 poster of flat shapes (crops are visible on it) | Thumbnails |
| `images/portrait.webp` | a 900 × 1400 figure off-centre — the `attention` crop finds the face | Thumbnails |
| `images/grid.png` | a labelled 8 × 5 grid: which cells each crop and size keeps | Thumbnails |
| `documents/ocr-sample.pdf` | one A4 page of Helvetica text (an invoice number, an amount) for the OCR job | Browse (`/info` → `ocr`) |
| `documents/notes.txt` | plain text: no thumbnail, `attachment` download | Browse |
| `media/clip.mp4` | 8 s of `testsrc2` at 480 × 270, H.264 baseline + AAC, `faststart`; `is_global_public` | Range & streaming |
| `media/tone.mp3` | 12 s of three sine tones, MP3 64 kb/s; `is_global_public` | Range & streaming |
| `encrypted/vault-poster.png` | a 1000 × 700 poster, uploaded with `encryption=tenant` | Encrypted files |
| `encrypted/confidential.pdf` | a one-page PDF, uploaded with `encryption=tenant` | Encrypted files |

About 620 KiB in all.

## How the seeder places them

- Each entry is **upserted under its `slug`** (`PUT /files/demo/<id>/slug/<slug>`), attributed
  to `X-User-Id: seeder`. A restart of the stack re-runs the seeder and changes nothing when
  the bytes are the same (`unchanged` in its summary).
- `folder` is the folder path the file lands in (`images/`, `documents/`, `media/`,
  `encrypted/`), created when missing.
- `encryption: tenant` entries need the server's key file (`VOLA_KEY_FILE`); without it the
  seeder stops with `503 encryption_unavailable` — put the key file in place first
  (`docs/EXAMPLES-SITE.md`).
- `public: true` entries are set `is_global_public` afterwards, so the `<video>` and `<audio>`
  of the streaming page can load them from `/vola/public/:id` without a key.
- The seeder's files are the only ones the demo keeps: the write proxy refuses to rename,
  move or delete them, and the purge never selects them.
